hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'deploy.sh'; then last_test=$(find quality/tests -name '*.py' -newer custom_components/universal_room_automation/const.py 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$last_test" ]; then echo 'WARNING: Tests may not have been run since last code change' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q 'git commit' && printf '{"systemMessage":"VibeMemo: Before committing, check for uncaptured decisions. Run /vibememo-eval (Part 1 capture + narrative update). Also synthesize user narratives into project narrative — commits are a consistency checkpoint."}' || printf '{}'

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}'   || true ;; esac

printf '{"systemMessage":"VibeMemo session-end: Run /vibememo-eval (Part 1 + Part 2) before closing. Capture uncaptured decisions, score all 9 eval dimensions, and synthesize user narratives into project narrative."}'

python3 -c "import json;print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'SessionStart','additionalContext':'ura-kanban session start: LOAD the ura-kanban skill now. Then apply any queued operator dispositions (docs/planning/kanban.dispositions.pending.jsonl), run python3 scripts/kanban_render.py --check (exit 0=fresh, 2=stale, 3=unapplied dispositions) and reconcile BEFORE reporting status. The WSJF-ranked board is the source of what to work next; drive Tier<=2 autonomously after the parsimony/cost-benefit gate, pause for Tier 3+.'}}))"
